name: V4D (Voxel for 4D Novel View Synthesis)
definition: A voxel-based architecture for 4D novel view synthesis in dynamic scenes using single-view video, modeling the 4D neural radiance field directly without a canonical space.
summary: V4D is a voxel-based architecture for 4D novel view synthesis that models neural radiance fields directly from single-view video using a dual-voxel structure and LUT refinement to recover high-frequency details.
